tagline: 尼康胶片单反相机，1984 年发布
description: 尼康于1984年推出的胶片单反相机。配备by button on the left of the lens flange。快门速度electronically-controlled vertical-travel, metal focal plane shutter。Matte Fresnel lens focusing screen with central split-image rangefinder spot and microprism collar (Nikon Type K clear-matte screen), ring and dial on the lens。

specs.镜头: by button on the left of the lens flange
specs.对焦: Matte Fresnel lens focusing screen with central split-image rangefinder spot and microprism collar (Nikon Type K clear-matte screen), ring and dial on the lens
specs.快门: electronically-controlled vertical-travel, metal focal plane shutter
specs.取景器: fixed eyelevel pentaprism type, meter needle and scale, manuel setting's indication M red led and flash ready signals on the left side of the finder
specs.曝光测光: aperture-priority automatic exposure with manual override and backup mechanical control; through-the-lens full aperture center-weighted metering
specs.电池: one 3V lithium battery or 1.55V silver-oxide batteries (SR44) or two 1.5V alkaline-manganese batteries (LR-44)
specs.卡口: Nikon bayonet, filter thread: 52mm, (a late Ai-S lens)
